content:
One of my favorite Apple TV 4K features—the screensaver—may soon get audio in tvOS 27, according to the latest leaks. Details below.

tvOS 27 code shows that at least one Apple TV screensaver will be getting an audio option, and there will likely be more

October is expected to be a very busy month for Apple, with several new hardware and software products launching.

Among the rumored products is a new Apple TV 4K, with images already surfacing in Apple's code earlier.

On the software side, leaker pdfu has just published evidence found in the tvOS 27 code, showing that at least one Apple TV screensaver will soon support audio.

As seen in the video above, there is a hidden option within the Snoopy screensaver to turn audio on or off, or use a 'reduced' setting.

The example of the Snoopy screensaver doesn't look like it will be too disruptive, but I'm glad Apple plans to allow users to completely turn off the audio.

Although pdfu hasn't found other screensavers supporting audio for now, it's very likely that Apple will extend this feature to more screensavers in the future.

What do you think about tvOS 27 potentially adding audio options to Apple TV screensavers? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments section.
